title: Divorce American Style
description: A couple (Dick Van Dyke, Debbie Reynolds) break up after 15 years of marriage, then get back together as the easy way out.

title: From Here to Eternity
description: While a Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor looms, an Army sergeant (Burt Lancaster), a former boxer (Montgomery Clift) and an officer's wife (Deborah Kerr) become entangled with others at an Army base on Oahu.

title: The Chance of a Lifetime
description: Sleuth Boston Blackie (Chester Morris) helps a wartime convict (Erik Rolf) framed for murder while out on parole.

title: The 7th Voyage of Sinbad
description: Sinbad the sailor (Kerwin Mathews) needs the egg of a giant two-headed bird of prey to restore a shrunken princess (Kathryn Grant).

title: The Howards of Virginia
description: Politics divide a Williamsburg couple (Cary Grant, Martha Scott) as events lead to the Revolutionary War.

title: Autumn Leaves
description: A New England spinster (Joan Crawford) marries a younger man (Cliff Robertson) who has mental problems and another wife (Vera Miles).

title: Port Afrique
description: An American (Phil Carey) returns to Morocco and discovers his wife's past while probing her death.

title: The Last Hurrah
description: An aging New England politician struggles to maintain his position as mayor in a hard-fought and questionable campaign.

title: First Men in the Moon
description: An old man (Edward Judd) recalls how he, his fiancée (Martha Hyer) and a professor (Lionel Jeffries) planted a Union Jack on the moon in 1899.

title: The End of the Affair
description: A civil servant's wife (Deborah Kerr) in wartime London vows to leave her injured lover (Van Johnson) if he recovers.

title: Gidget Goes to Rome
description: Teenage Gidget (Cindy Carol) and boyfriend Moondoggie (James Darren) cause romantic confusion on vacation in Italy.

title: We Were Strangers
description: A Cuban (Jennifer Jones) lets a rebel (John Garfield) use her home as a base for digging a tunnel to blow up a dictatorship.

title: Oliver!
description: Dickens' Oliver Twist goes from parish boy to Fagin's pickpocketing school to the clutches of murderous Bill Sikes.

title: Eight Iron Men
description: GIs sit in a bombed-out house with a comrade trapped outside; then one (Bonar Colleano) does something.

title: The Black Knight
description: A common swordsmith (Alan Ladd) freelances for King Arthur to prove himself worthy of an earl's daughter (Patricia Medina).

title: The Bitter Tea of General Yen
description: A U.S. missionary (Barbara Stanwyck) is gradually seduced by a courtly warlord (Nils Asther) holding her in Shanghai.

title: Pushover
description: A gangster's girlfriend (Kim Novak) seduces a police detective (Fred MacMurray) who has her under surveillance.

title: Ten Cents a Dance
description: After marrying a man who becomes a thief, a taxi dancer runs off to Europe to get a divorce and marry another man.

title: The Doctor Takes a Wife
description: A writer (Loretta Young) and a neurologist (Ray Milland) accept rumors of their marriage when each stands to gain from the mistake.

title: Bonjour tristesse
description: At the height of summer, 18-year-old Cécile is relaxing by the French seaside with her father and falling in love with her new boyfriend. However, the arrival of her late mother's enigmatic friend soon turns her world upside down.

title: Operation Mad Ball
description: An Army private (Jack Lemmon) and his buddies try to fraternize with nurses who are off-limits as officers.

title: The Cockleshell Heroes
description: A British major (Jose Ferrer) and captain (Trevor Howard) lead marines in canoes on a mission to mine Nazi ships in Bordeaux.

title: The Fuller Brush Man
description: A door-to-door salesman (Red Skelton) and his girlfriend (Janet Blair) solve a murder and wind up trapped in a war-surplus warehouse.

title: Bell, Book and Candle
description: A witch's (Kim Novak) warlock brother (Jack Lemmon) helps a San Francisco publisher (James Stewart) break a love spell.

title: Five Easy Pieces
description: A former concert pianist (Jack Nicholson) who works in an oil field takes his waitress girlfriend (Karen Black) to visit his wealthy, cultured family.

title: From Here to Eternity
description: While a Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor looms, an Army sergeant (Burt Lancaster), a former boxer (Montgomery Clift) and an officer's wife (Deborah Kerr) become entangled with others at an Army base on Oahu.

title: The Taming of the Shrew
description: Shakespeare's Petruchio weds Katharina on his own terms in Padua.

title: The Long Gray Line
description: On the eve of his retirement, an Irish immigrant looks back upon his lifetime of service to West Point military academy.

title: The Wrecking Crew
description: Secret agent Matt Helm (Dean Martin) and a blonde (Sharon Tate) track $1 billion in gold in the last of four Matt Helm movies.

title: The Guilt of Janet Ames
description: A World War II widow (Rosalind Russell) overcomes a mental block thanks to one (Melvyn Douglas) of the five soldiers her husband died for.

title: The Magic Carpet
description: An ousted prince harnesses the power of a mystical floor covering to drive a villainous caliph from the throne.

title: It Had to Be You
description: A marriage-shy sculptor (Ginger Rogers) meets the Indian boy of her childhood dreams, now a firefighter (Cornel Wilde).

title: You Can't Run Away From It
description: A newsman (Jack Lemmon) rides a bus, hitchhikes and shares a cabin with a tycoon's (Charles Bickford) runaway daughter (June Allyson).

title: Guess Who's Coming to Dinner
description: White liberals must overcome their own latent racism when their strong-willed daughter announces her intention to marry a distinguished black physician.

title: A Man for All Seasons
description: Sir Thomas More (Paul Scofield) opposes Henry VIII's (Robert Shaw) appointing himself head of the Church of England.

title: Funny Girl
description: Ziegfeld Follies star Fanny Brice (Barbra Streisand) falls for gambler Nicky Arnstein (Omar Sharif).

title: The Ambushers
description: A secret agent (Dean Martin) saves a flying-saucer prototype and its pilot (Janice Rule) in the third of four Matt Helm movies.

title: Shockproof
description: An ex-convict (Patricia Knight) flees with her Los Angeles parole officer (Cornel Wilde) after shooting her former lover (John Baragrey).

title: 5 Against the House
description: Friends (Guy Madison, Kim Novak, Brian Keith) join a college student's scheme to rob a Reno casino for kicks.

title: The Chase
description: An escaped convict (Robert Redford) heads for his wife (Jane Fonda) and corrupt small-town Texans, who order a sheriff (Marlon Brando) to stop him.
